# FLX-3714: a consumer query holds a LIKE pattern of more than 512 characters

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A LIKE or ILIKE pattern is written into the text that counts the rows meeting a requirement and is matched at init, so its length is bounded at 512 characters. Shorten the pattern.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3714
```
